what: The picture manual: per photograph its caption, its size in pixels (width, height) and the scale references in view. The poses of the camera and its lens are not known.

photos.caption: The whole assembly cell before the work starts: the base clamped on its stand, the legs standing in their stations, the arms and the head on the rack table, and the industrial arm at its home position. The camera portal stands over the cell, and the hoist hangs from the beam of the lifting gantry at the upper left.
scale_references: the datum boards on the floor and on the fixtures

photos.caption: The base on its stand, seen from above and from its front left: the toggle clamps on the pelvis, the left hip output flange, the open left shoulder socket, the neck output and the torso brace.
scale_references: the hip output flange, dimensioned on the hip interface sheet
the stand, dimensioned on the stand sheet

photos.caption: The base on its stand, seen from behind and above: the stand's rear upright, the bar of the torso brace behind the base, and beyond them the legs standing in their stations.
scale_references: the stand's datum board

photos.caption: The right hip output flange close up: the ring of holes on the black output face, the pilot spigot and the gold limit ring with its stops.
scale_references: the hip output flange, dimensioned on the hip interface sheet

photos.caption: The right shoulder socket seen along its axis: the collar, the bore and the ring of clearance holes in the torso shell. The left arm is already mounted in this photograph: the grey disc deep inside the bore is the left arm's shoulder end seen through the hollow torso, not a part of this socket.
scale_references: the shoulder socket, dimensioned on the shoulder socket sheet

photos.caption: The neck output seen from above: the boss with its screw heads inside the opening of the neck plate.
scale_references: the neck output and the neck plate's opening, dimensioned on the neck interface sheet

photos.caption: The right leg standing in its station, seen from its front right, with the left leg in its station behind it; the steel rule beside it stands at the right leg's distance from the camera.
scale_references: the steel rule

photos.caption: The right leg's hip bracket close up, seen from above with the leg standing in its station: the shallow bore with the ring of holes in its floor, and the limit lug at its side.
scale_references: the leg's bracket, dimensioned on the hip interface sheet

photos.caption: The right arm hanging in its rack at the joint angles it is delivered with, seen from above and from its outer side: the shoulder ring at the top, the elbow below.
scale_references: the arm, dimensioned on the shoulder socket sheet

photos.caption: The right arm held above its rack by the gripper, its shoulder ring and the end of its actuator housing seen from the side that faces the socket.
scale_references: the arm's shoulder ring, dimensioned on the shoulder socket sheet

photos.caption: The head standing upright in its nest inside the ring of slats, seen from above and from its front right.
scale_references: the head and its nest, whose sizes the mesh files give

photos.caption: The head held up by the gripper, its bracket seen from below: the shallow bore with the ring of holes in its floor, of which the position at the left has no hole. The dark edge inside the hole at the right is the edge of a plate inside the head, behind the bracket.
scale_references: the head's bracket, dimensioned on the neck interface sheet

photos.caption: The right leg held by the gripper beside the right hip, before it is seated, seen from behind the base. The narrow open gap between the leg's bracket and the hip flange is near the middle of the frame, just to the right of the stand's white upright; the left leg, at the left edge, still stands in its station.
scale_references: the hip output flange, dimensioned on the hip interface sheet

photos.caption: Both legs mounted on the base, seen from its front right, with the shoulder socket on this side still empty; the empty leg stations stand in the foreground, and an arm still hangs in its rack behind.
scale_references: the stand's datum board

photos.caption: The left arm held by the gripper outside the left shoulder socket, on the socket's axis and not yet in it, with both legs already mounted. The ribbed silver part between the socket and the arm's shoulder ring is the arm's own neck: its ribs are separate rings, not a thread.
scale_references: the shoulder socket's collar, dimensioned on the shoulder socket sheet

photos.caption: Both legs and both arms mounted on the base, seen from the front; the neck output is still empty.
scale_references: the stand's datum board

photos.caption: The finished robot on its stand, seen from the front.
scale_references: the stand's datum board

photos.caption: The finished robot on its stand, seen from its front right.
scale_references: the stand's datum board

photos.caption: The finished robot on its stand, seen from behind and from its left.
scale_references: the stand's datum board

photos.caption: The finished robot on its stand, seen from its front left.
scale_references: the stand's datum board
